items.reason: The PR adds the misleading Django negative-slicing claim at src/sentry/api/paginator.py:876, while lines 880–882 pass the negative offset directly into queryset slicing. The permission assurance at line 879 is also unsupported by the paginator: build_queryset at lines 79–128 only adjusts ordering and cursor filtering. The issue requests comment corrections, so it is a documentation nit rather than a behavioral defect.
